source_document: DEFM14C (SEC, filed 2023-05-11) — 'Certain Unaudited Prospective Financial Information' (Ten-Year Projections table)
source_text: Management's Ten-Year Projections show Non-GAAP Operating Income margin expanding from approximately 12.5% in FY2023E to approximately 26.7% in FY2027E, driven by operating leverage as the subscription base scales. Used as the EBITDA-margin proxy here since the company does not disclose a GAAP EBITDA figure (GAAP operating income is negative due to stock-based compensation).

metadata.ambiguity_note: Non-GAAP operating margin used as the EBITDA-margin proxy; not a GAAP-equivalent figure.
